guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Visit the BaiBai App
guide.description: Go to the BaiBai app and click “Connect Wallet.” Switch your wallet to the Base network if it isn’t there already.

guide.description: You need USDC or ETH on Base to trade. You can buy either asset on Bybit and withdraw directly to Base. Holding funds on another chain? Move them over with the bridge widget below. guide.title: Make Your First Swap
guide.description: Pick the token you want to sell and the one you want to buy, enter an amount, and review the quote. Click “Trade,” approve the token if prompted, and sign. No gas is needed.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Pick the token you want to sell and the one you want to buy, enter an amount, and review the quote. Click “Trade,” approve the token if prompted, and sign. No gas is needed.

guide.title: Trade Regularly to Build Points
guide.description: Points are based on trading volume and activity. Spread trades across different days and token pairs instead of placing one large swap, and check the app for any active multipliers before you trade.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Points are based on trading volume and activity. Spread trades across different days and token pairs instead of placing one large swap, and check the app for any active multipliers before you trade.

guide.title: Trade Tokenized Stocks for Boosted Points
guide.description: If tokenized stocks are available in your jurisdiction, swap into them on BaiBai. These trades have earned a temporary 2x points boost, so confirm the multiplier is still running first.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Trade Tokenized Stocks for Boosted Points
